items.title: As Corporate Bond Markets Grow, Is Bank Lending Shrinking?
items.excerpt: The size of global corporate bond markets has increased dramatically over the past three decades. As of the end of 2024, nonfinancial corporate bonds issued by U.S. firms accounted for 29 percent of U.S. GDP. In other advanced economies, though bond markets remain smaller than in the U.S., corporate bonds were on average 11 percent of GDP in the same year. …
